2 / 7 · Architecture, Mission & Five Values

Three focused menus. Five non-negotiable rules of scientific honesty.

Story introduces the mission, Academy trains hypothesis testing, and Cockpit exposes raw NASA telemetry. Every chart obeys Seasonal Mann-Kendall (period = 12) + Theil-Sen with explicit live vs. frozen disclosure.

Proof before story
No trend claim without tau, p-value, and 95% confidence band.
Publish when wrong
Null results (wind WS2M) stay visible instead of hidden hype.
Not a black box
Deterministic falsification workbench with full CSV/JSON export.

3 / 7 · Trends in Human Language (1984–2025)

Forty-two years of NASA measurements translated into a citizen traffic light.

Instead of expecting citizens to decode p < 1e-16, we convert audited Theil-Sen slopes across three Brazilian biomes into Red / Amber / Green briefings backed by verifiable numbers.

Campinas-SP (Atlantic)
+0.409 °C/dec · 95% CI [+0.333, +0.489] · +1.718 °C total
Petrolina & Manaus
+0.301 °C/dec (+1.265 °C) · Manaus +0.307 °C/dec (+1.287 °C)
Declared Null (WS2M)
Surface wind p = 0.489 / 0.173 / 0.451 -> Green stable, no hourly claim.
Deterministic stats: pymannkendall (period=12) + scipy.stats.theilslopes (95% CI) Slide 3 / 7
4 / 7 · Attribution + Earthdata CMR MCP

One statistical engine. Opposite physical drivers.

Surface sunlight can rise because clouds vanished OR because dry-sky haze changed. Comparing All-Sky vs. Clear-Sky radiation alongside Earthdata CMR metadata separates the cause cleanly.

Manaus & Petrolina
Cloud attenuation falls (-0.855 & -0.965 %/dec), Clear-Sky null -> Cloud-driven.
Campinas-SP
Clouds null (p = 0.948), Clear-Sky rises (+0.190 MJ/m2/day/dec) -> Aerosol/haze.
CMR Provenance
Verified C3264430167-LANCEMODIS (VIIRS) & NISAR_L2_GUNW_PROVISIONAL_V1.
Scientific honesty: every vector declares live, frozen snapshot, or parametric model status Slide 4 / 7
5 / 7 · Layperson Action Presets

Five real-world questions replace cryptic variable codes.

Non-specialists pick the decision they care about — Heatwaves, Drought, Wildfires, Solar Storm, or City Health — and immediately receive a traffic-light verdict, action step, and hover glossary.

Heatwaves & Drought
Couples temperature, solar irradiance, rainfall, humidity, and clouds.
Wildfires (150 km)
Joins 24h VIIRS hotspots nearby with cloudless air dryness.
Hover Glossary
Interactive definitions for Theil-Sen, p-value, Mann-Kendall & Tau.

6 / 7 · Trend Detective Academy & Live Proof

Who grades your hypothesis is the statistical engine — never an LLM.

Adapted from HKUDS/DeepTutor without server logins: type a nickname, complete five real-data challenges, pass a mathematically realistic mastery gate (>= 0.80), and earn a printable diploma while Ask OMNI answers strictly from telemetry.

7 / 7 · Earth Duck Curve -> Off-World Frontiers (MPTO)

Same thermodynamic guardrail from Brazil's grid to Moon & Mars habitats.

Open feeds (NASA DSN Now, OSDR OSD-615 plant cell-walls, CelesTrak GP) meet our 4-layer Multi-Physics Orchestrator: T^4 radiator saturation, sintered regolith thermal batteries (~50x k), lunar IR albedo (+10-15%), and rover dispatch.
